channel.title: Data-Engineering on Junho Lee
channel.description: Recent content in Data-Engineering on Junho Lee

item.title: 4. SCD - When a Customer Moves, Where Were Past Orders Shipped?
item.description: When dimension data changes, do you overwrite history or preserve it? We implement SCD Type 1, 2, and 3 differences in SQL, then build a production pattern with dbt snapshot.

item.title: 3. Silver Layer - Promoting Bronze to an Analysis-Ready State
item.description: Cleanse and standardize the raw data stacked in Bronze. Fix types, unify column names, remove duplicates. We define this process as SQL models in dbt.

item.title: 2. Bronze Layer - Load the Source Data Exactly As-Is
item.description: There are two ways to load data into Bronze. Overwrite everything, or bring only what changed. Which one you choose completely changes the complexity of your pipeline.

item.title: 1. Medallion Architecture - Why We Stack Data in Three Layers
item.description: Bronze, Silver, Gold. What changes when you load data into separate layers. We build it hands-on with DuckDB and dbt.

item.title: Quail: High-Throughput AI-SQL Engine Co-Optimizing Query Plans and LLMs
item.description: Quail jointly optimizes SQL execution plans and LLM KV cache reuse, beating vLLM on 27 of 29 AI-SQL benchmark queries with a 1.84x geometric mean speedup.

item.title: 5. Data Modeling in the LLM Era
item.description: Notes from reading all seven references cited in a post arguing that data modeling comes before code. Covers the principles that outlasted three generations of tooling, four history-tracking patterns used in production, and organizational debt — the slowest debt to surface.

item.title: Why Data Analysis Agents Should Query a Semantic Layer Instead of Writing SQL
item.description: Replace raw schema dumps and free-form LLM SQL generation with a Semantic Layer over granular fact tables for 100% syntax-safe analytical queries.

item.title: fenic: A Semantic DataFrame Engine Combining LLMs and SQL
item.description: fenic integrates PySpark/SQL-style relational operations with LLM-powered semantic operators to process structured and unstructured data in typed pipelines.

item.title: MemPalace: A Local Open-Source Hierarchical Memory System for AI
item.description: MemPalace organizes local AI memory into hierarchical Wings, Rooms, and Drawers on top of Python and ChromaDB, reaching up to 98.4% hybrid retrieval accuracy.

item.title: Optimizing Korean Search on Databricks AI Search with Kiwi
item.description: Databricks AI Search lacks built-in Nori support. Adding pre-index morphological tokenization and synonym expansion with Kiwi boosts Korean BM25 recall.

item.title: Five Stages of AI Adoption and Overcoming the Verification Tax
item.description: Why enterprise AI initiatives stall in the J-curve trap under heavy human Verification Tax, and how engineers shift toward designing verification loops.

item.title: agentdir: Safe Read-Only Virtual Workspaces for AI Agents
item.description: Built in Rust, agentdir projects scattered local files into clean read-only Copy-on-Write directory trees so AI agents work fast without touching originals.

item.title: LLM Graph Builder: Turning Unstructured Files into Neo4j Knowledge Graphs
item.description: Open-source LLM Graph Builder extracts nodes and relationships from PDFs, videos, and web pages into Neo4j for hybrid vector and graph querying.

item.title: Gemini-SQL2 Crosses 80% Execution Accuracy on the BIRD Benchmark
item.description: Google’s specialized Gemini-SQL2 model hits 80.04% execution accuracy on BIRD, highlighting domain fine-tuning gains and cloud data platform integration.

item.title: Operating an AI-Native Startup with Agents and Overnight Learning Loops
item.description: How AI-native startups delegate routine execution to agents, run overnight feedback loops, and shift engineers toward system architecture and reliability.

item.title: Browser-Based SQL-to-ERD Visualizer with Local DDL Parsing
item.description: A local-first browser tool that parses SQL DDL statements in memory and renders interactive ERDs without uploading schemas to external servers.

item.title: Designing Self-Service Data Analytics Agents with Claude
item.description: Engineering practices for self-service analytics agents, covering data warehouse hygiene, verified semantic layers, CI checks, and Markdown skills.

item.title: How Decades of Document Parsing Tech Topped GitHub Trending
item.description: A Korean software company hit #1 on GitHub Trending by open-sourcing its PDF extraction engine instead of selling a monolithic office suite.

item.title: 5. Automating Metadata Maintenance: Karpathy's LLM Wiki Architecture
item.description: RAG starts from scratch every time. Karpathy proposes having the LLM maintain a wiki directly so knowledge accumulates. DataNexus’s ontology catalog needs the same principle to avoid abandonment.

item.title: Streaming 1 Million Excel Rows in Spring Boot Without OOM via StreamSheet
item.description: StreamSheet exports 1 million rows to Excel in Spring Boot without OutOfMemoryErrors, replacing repetitive Apache POI streaming boilerplate with one annotation.

item.title: Unexpected Limits When Extracting Web Pages to Markdown with defuddle
item.description: Testing defuddle for RAG web ingestion shows sharp quality swings: non-semantic HTML mixes ads into body text, while client-rendered pages drop content.

item.title: Why Preprocessing Drives RAG Quality: Converting Docs with MarkItDown
item.description: MarkItDown converts PDFs and Office files into Markdown while preserving tables and heading hierarchies, cutting RAG preprocessing work.

item.title: 1. Is Kimball Still Relevant in the Cloud DW Era?
item.description: How DW modeling considerations have shifted with Synapse, BigQuery, and Redshift. Kimball, Data Vault, One Big Table — practical criteria for choosing the right approach.
